scope: Controller-side classification before construction and target analysis; not a builder prompt and not calibrated confidence
classification_rule: A new target estimate can be withheld while its qualitative relation is already present in source literature. Report transport success separately from genuinely unreported relation support.

adjusted_age_per10.gap: Standardization, adjustment sets, selection and populations differ. Not discovery of an age-insulin relationship.

adjusted_bmi_per5.gap: Log-BMI simple association, clamp-adjusted GEE, and reverse-conditional tertile summaries do not directly give the target log-insulin coefficient per five raw BMI units.

bmi_curvature_second_difference.gap: No admitted source directly identifies target quadratic curvature. Agent functional form may itself create the sign; structural sensitivity is needed.

female_minus_male_bmi_slope_per5.gap: A difference in correlations is not a difference in adjusted slopes; stratum variances and conditional structure matter.

derived_homa1_ir_mean.gap: Derived from generated insulin and observed glucose. Several log-linear adjusted associations are algebraically redundant.

adjusted_age_per10.gap: Source age effects are already provided. Target lag, assay, population and case mix differ; PNS pooled model also differs from sex-specific source regressions.

adjusted_bmi_per5.gap: Hoorn effects condition on glucose/waist/lifestyle, DIRECT predicts future HbA1c. Neither is a ready target age-sex-adjusted raw-BMI slope.

bmi_curvature_second_difference.gap: Categorized effects in different adjustment/time settings do not identify this full-domain quadratic projection.

female_minus_male_bmi_slope_per5.gap: Extra covariates, prospective horizon and cohort calibration differ; a source-specific sex difference is not an identified target interaction.

all_secondary_cells.gap: Available sex marginals do not identify target age-sex-BMI cells. All prespecified cells remain in evaluation, including sparse or unfavorable ones.
